notes: Vertical stiles of the gate frame were interpreted by observer as side posts, but they match the height of the gate frame rather than being tall flanking gate posts.

blind.description: A rustic wooden gate composed of two sturdy vertical side posts, horizontal wooden rails, and a diagonal cross-brace. Dark iron or steel hinge straps and brackets are mounted onto the posts on either side. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and textured with realistic wood grain and dark metal finishes, with no floating or distorted geometry.
blind.from_above: A thin, elongated rectangle with square end blocks representing the post tops, connected by the narrow top rail, with small metal hinge brackets protruding at the sides.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 3 feet tall (roughly half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and around 3 feet wide.
